project.name: ihris-common
project.title: iHRIS Common
project.summary: iHRIS Common includes common page classes, template files and images for the iHRIS Suite of software: iHRIS Manage, iHRIS Qualify and iHRIS Plan. iHRIS Common is free and Open Source software distributed under the GPL.
